message: A curl network call inside .onLoad or .onAttach sends an outbound HTTP request automatically when a package is loaded. Matches curl_fetch_memory(), curl_fetch_disk(), curl_fetch_stream(), curl_download(), and multi_run(), both qualified (curl::) and unqualified.

source() inside .onLoad or .onAttach executes R code automatically when a package is loaded. The sourced file may be bundled with the package, read from an ambient filesystem location (e.g., the working directory), or fetched from a URL; in the latter two cases the payload can change after the package passes review, bypassing static analysis. The origin of the argument should be classified during manual review.
